notes: Dedicated changelog/about/news URLs 404. Usable surrogates retrieved: KFG History, KFG Excel specification (T=Top cord, U=Unknown in the same Attachment column), and each khipu's Excel ChangeLog sheet. OKR attachment_dc lists only R,V,H; ATTACHMENT_TYPE is never T (0/54403); top cords are stored as CORD_CLASSIFICATION=T (249 cords: 191 U, 30 V, 28 R) and cord_cluster.GROUPING_CLASS=T. All four targets follow the majority pattern (U + classification T). KFG recoded Attachment U->T in Nov-Dec 2025; OKR cord CHANGED_ON max 2020-04-18 (git commit 4039ca5 dated 2026-08-04 on GitHub, data inside not updated then). Not isolated errors and not missing top-cord flags in OKR.
